entities.summary: Yoshie Hotta was a Japanese writer of novels, short stories, poetry and essays, noted for his political consciousness. His most acclaimed works include Hiroba no kodoku, which was awarded the Akutagawa Prize, and Kage no bubun. Hotta has also been associated with the Atomic bomb literature genre. Yoshie Hotta was a authors & novelists from Takaoka (1918-07-07, Takaoka–1998-09-05). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
